# Boolean Array To Number

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Convert the bits true, false, true into the unsigned integer 5. The first element is bit zero.

## What this example demonstrates

Convert the bits true, false, true into the unsigned integer 5. The first element is bit zero.
